dataset: Mumbai Ward-Level Population Density and Social Vulnerability
source: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (Census 2011) & BMC Public Health Vital Statistics
temporal_resolution: 2011 Census base with 2024 BMC civic demographic projections
limitations: Ward-level aggregation does not resolve intra-ward building-scale micro-density. Extreme densities occur in Dharavi (GN) and Govandi (ME) reaching up to 100,000+ persons/sq km locally.
processing: Synthesized from Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract (PCA) and municipal civic health reports into standardized GeoJSON polygons.
notes: Essential for flood exposure calculation: Expected Affected Population = Sum(Inundated Area * Population Density).
